ic_name: Single Edge Nibble Transmission (SENT, SAE J2716)

bit_waveform.modulation: single-wire push-pull pulse; falling-edge-to-falling-edge period in ticks carries the nibble value
bit_waveform.clock_recovery: tick time from the 56-tick calibration pulse; no forwarded clock.

nibble_waveform.edge: each pulse begins with a falling edge; measure to the next falling edge.

frame_waveform.crc: 4-bit CRC (CRC-4) nibble after the data nibbles.
frame_waveform.pause: optional pause pulse pads the frame to a constant length.

spc_waveform.trigger: ECU master trigger pulse starts a frame (synchronous).
spc_waveform.response: sensor returns a standard SENT frame.
spc_waveform.addressing: trigger pulse width selects the data channel.

general_timing_rule: Each frame begins with the 56-tick synchronization/calibration pulse the receiver uses to recover the tick time; nibble values are decoded as round(period_ticks / tick_time) - 12.
